szoveg_eredeti:
Meet Pika H3 Flex, debuting today as the #1 open weight model on Intelligence (Design Arena) t2v board.

It’s built for professional iteration, with exportable audio stems, resolutions up to 4k, and faster-than-realtime generation. It can produce a 15-second clip with soundtrack in as little as 7 seconds.

Pika H3 Flex ranks at #7 in overall quality. We post-trained Pika H3 Flex on MiniMax H3. And we’re proud and humbled to share that we’ve outranked them, and H3Max, on the leaderboard.

In the spirit of iteration, we’re making Pika H3 Flex open source from day 1. You can find the code on GitHub , the weights on Hugging Face , and start playing with it in ComfyUI and diffusers right now.

Try Pika H3 Flex for yourself on the Pika API Club. Prices start at $0.01/sec, and we’re giving away 15 generations per day, for the next two weeks.

Start here: https://lnkd.in/gNPQBE38
